query: Royal Auto Detailing, Port St. Lucie, FL
name: Royal Auto Detailing
address: 593 SW Biltmore St, Port St. Lucie, FL 34983, United States
hours: Open 24 hours, every day (mobile detailer, flexible scheduling)

reviewSamples.author: Sonaya Dasilva
reviewSamples.text: Royal Auto Detailing delivers an exceptional experience from the very first interaction, with clear communication, honesty, and transparency throughout the entire process. He is incredibly patient, kind, and genuinely a pleasure to work with.

reviewSamples.author: Stephen Spampani
reviewSamples.text: These guys are amazing! Peterson and his crew did a wonderful job on my 2 vehicles. He was very friendly and prompt. I had scratches on my glass, he was able to buff them out when no other detailer would touch them. My cars look brand new, would definitely recommend him to anyone looking for a great detailer.

reviewSamples.author: Diana Bautista
reviewSamples.text: I initially wanted my seats just shampooed but I ended up doing everything, interior detail and exterior as well! My seats look amazing and brand new. I still can't get over the difference of the before and after! I highly recommend, amazing price!

reviewSamples.author: Adriana Silva
reviewSamples.text: Peterson did an excellent job polishing the exterior of my car. The paint now has an incredible shine, we are very pleased. He showed up on time, answered all our questions, we highly recommend his service to anyone looking for a high-quality finish!

reviewSamples.author: Vivian Le
reviewSamples.text: They did a really good job, they got the little spots I couldn't get and left my paint and tires looking amazing. I'm more than satisfied!

notes: Mobile detailer (open 24 hours, flexible scheduling). Owner/lead tech named Peterson in multiple Google reviews. No own website found (web search confirmed, checked common domain variants and Facebook/Instagram presence: none found). No public email found after deep search; outreach is pending_manual via phone. Of the 11 Google Maps photo URLs provided, 3 were dropped after stricter visual review: one duplicate of the hero shot, one generic parking-lot photo with no distinguishing detail, and one showing a commercial building with a different, unrelated business's signage (contamination risk) — left with 7 confidently-real, internally consistent photos (two show the exact same white Lamborghini Huracan at the exact same residential property, confirming genuine sourcing).
